outcome: F-55 HR stand-in sample data: work, detail, assistant and a line to start
acceptance_criteria: My work for `hr` shows sample rows in all three queues: Needs me (at least 3, e.g. confirm November staff list for payroll matching, resolve 2 staff with no business unit, answer Finance's question on a leaver), Waiting on others (at least 3, e.g. Finance matching the staff list, HR Lead deciding a payroll correction), Done (at least 2). Counts, filters and search work. — verify: e2e as hr.

Each HR row opens a work item page (/work/[id]) with header, facts, station track, agent card and the next step, plus a History tab with at least 5 entries (person, agent, evidence, one Restricted entry). — verify: e2e opens two HR items and their history.
Alerts: the bell and Notifications show at least 3 HR alerts linking to those items. — verify: e2e.

Assistant: the hr conversation list has at least 4 conversations with Zainab, each opening a full thread (person message, agent steps, answer, sources, and a draft or result card where it fits). One conversation asks for a salary and Zainab declines to show amounts, explaining payroll visibility is not set up yet and who can see it. Sending a new message to Zainab as hr returns a sensible mock reply. — verify: e2e opens two conversations and sends one message.

Start work: `hr` can start the stand-in line "Send the staff list for payroll" (line_key `hr_staff_list`), marked as a stand-in in its description, through the existing start flow (choose month, attach the staff list file, start), landing on a new work item. The startable list in me.hr.json includes it. — verify: e2e start as hr.
hr still cannot open Projects, Exceptions or Setup (refused as today). Other personas' data is unchanged. — verify: existing e2e plus one hr refusal check.
checks.sh and the full e2e pass.
